caption: The drawing is created in black pencil on a beige or off-white background and consists of two main sketches depicting a dress. The largest sketch, positioned on the left, shows the front view of a floor-length, high-waisted dress with short puffed sleeves, a square neckline, and two shoulder straps. The bodice and sleeves feature a decorative band with leaf-like patterns, and similar ornamental embroidery is drawn along the bottom hem of the skirt. On the upper right, a smaller sketch shows the back view of the same dress, highlighting the open upper back with a V-shaped seam meeting at the waistband and the same decorative hem detail at the skirt's edge. The drawing occupies the upper three-fourths of the page, with the lower right portion left blank. The lines are precise and neat, with delicate detailing on the decorative elements.
title: Dress
